name: Auckland
scopeLimits: Auckland city-scoped verification of the shared LINZ current primary-parcel publication. The initial 13 aligned cells and four adjacent pans were expanded to 30 cells, a wider viewport and four pans around the unchanged WUP locator, yielding 184 distinct full parcel geometries. All 47 checks passed with the existing runtime descriptor: page size 100, native id identity, OBJECTID transport manifests, and safe appellation/topology labels. Forced three-row paging completed in 48 geometry pages; all 184 fresh native-id reads reproduced geometry; explicit absence, full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding passed. The WUP-containing native parcel 5211850 also matched its prior full geometry. GEOS in EPSG:32760 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The shared Wellington runtime settings are retained. Current primary parcels only; non-primary interests, historic/pending parcels, whole-city completeness, source publication freshness and identity continuity after revision remain unverified. Retain LINZ attribution and CC BY 4.0 conditions; source accuracy notices remain informational.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ publishes the NZ Primary Parcels layer as current official parcel polygons and links it to title interests; the exact Auckland locator returned one feature. The sample read did not request title, ownership, address or legal-description attributes.
remainingUncertainty: Auckland-wide completeness and exact source-to-city boundary coverage were not tested here; only current primary parcels are represented, while non-primary, historic and pending records are separate. City-specific pagination/quality checks remain for root review.
nextStep: Inspect enabled shared LINZ provider in headed Auckland app.
